name: Leon Alexander
main_effect:
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text, gain 1 memory.
[Main] ＜Mind Link＞ to 1 of your Digimon with [Pulsemon] in its text. (Place this Tamer as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card if there are no Tamer cards in its digivolution cards.)
source_effect:
[All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[End of All Turns] You may play 1 [Leon Alexander] from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
